# Statistical Significance of GPS Special Message Anomalies

## Setup

| Parameter | Value |

| Database | `/Users/smurdoch/w/gps-special-messages/data/messages.duckdb` |
| Unique messages | 5,009 |
| Null hypothesis alphabet | 45 symbols (GPS ICD IS-GPS-200 character set) |

## Test 1: Shared Substring Birthday Problem

**H0:** Messages are independent random draws from a 45-symbol alphabet.
Shared substrings of length L arise only by chance.

Corpus: N = 5009 messages, M = 22 bytes each, alphabet A = 45

## Test 2: TEXT Prefix Frequency

**H0:** Messages are random draws from A^22 (A = 45).
The probability of any specific 4-byte prefix is 1/A^4.

| Quantity | Value |
|---|---|
| P(specific 4-byte prefix) | 1/45^4 = 2.44e-07 |
| Expected under H0 | lambda = N * p = 0.001222 |
| Observed TEXT-prefixed | 55 |
| **p-value** | **< 10^-100** |

### PRN concentration

| Quantity | Value |
|---|---|
| Most concentrated PRN | PRN 21 (30/122 unique PRN-message pairs) |
| P(>= 30 on one PRN \| Binomial(122, 1/32)) | **1.25e-18** |

## Test 3: TEXT Message Entropy Ranking

**H0:** TEXT messages are drawn from the same PPM-D entropy distribution as all messages.

| Quantity | Value |
|---|---|
| Corpus mean entropy | 132.78 bits |
| TEXT messages below mean | 55 of 55 (100%) |
| Fraction of corpus below mean | 0.4797 |
| P(all 55 below mean) | **0.4797^55 = 2.85e-18** |

### Wilcoxon rank-sum test

| Quantity | Value |
|---|---|
| z-statistic | -12.0213 |
| **p-value** | **< 10^-100** |
| TEXT mean | 121.44 bits (5.52 bits/byte) |
| Non-TEXT mean | 132.90 bits (6.04 bits/byte) |

## Test 4: Sentinel (All-Same-Byte) Message Probability

**H0:** Messages are random draws from A^22 (A = 45).
P(all-same-byte) = A * (1/A)^22 = A^-21.

| Quantity | Value |
|---|---|
| P(all-same-byte in 22 positions) | 45^-21 = 1.92e-35 |
| Expected under H0 | lambda = 9.60e-32 |
| Observed sentinels | 3 |
| **p-value** | **< 10^-100** |

The three sentinel messages:

| Byte | Observations | First seen | Last seen |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0xAA | 19,377 | 2010-02-14 | 2020-07-22 |
| 0x00 | 3,844 | 2010-03-09 | 2018-08-20 |
| 0x20 | 1,025 | 2009-09-21 | 2009-10-01 |

Lambda is effectively zero. Even 1 sentinel is astronomically unlikely under the random null hypothesis.

## Test 5: KS Test — GPS vs Random Baseline Entropy Distribution

**H0:** GPS message PPM-D entropy distribution is identical to random baseline.

The random baseline is generated by simulating 100 independent corpora of 5009 messages each (500900 total), drawing uniformly from the 45-symbol GPS ICD alphabet, and computing PPM-D order-8 leave-one-out scores.

| Quantity | Value |
|---|---|
| GPS sample | n = 5,009 |
| Random sample | n = 500,900 |
| KS statistic D | 0.068006 |
| **p-value** | **2.04e-20** |

### Effect size

| | GPS | Random |
|---|---|---|
| Mean | 132.78 bits | 133.57 bits |
| SD | 7.50 bits | 4.47 bits |

| Cohen's d | -0.1284 | **negligible** |

P-values are two-sided under normal approximation.

## Test 7: TEXT Payload Randomness

**H0:** The 18-byte payloads of TEXT messages (bytes 5-22) are independent
random draws from the 45-symbol GPS ICD alphabet.

TEXT messages: 55, payload length: 18 bytes each

### Test 7a: KS test on PPM-D payload entropy

Build a PPM-D order-8 model on the 55 payloads alone,
score each via leave-one-out, and compare to a random 18-byte baseline.

| Quantity | Value |
|---|---|
| TEXT payload scores | n = 55, mean = 107.25 bits, SD = 3.10 bits |
| Random 18-byte scores | n = 5,500, mean = 107.29 bits, SD = 2.69 bits |
| KS statistic D | 0.1176 |
| **p-value** | **4.15e-01** |
| Cohen's d | -0.0140 (negligible) |

### Test 7b: Chi-squared goodness-of-fit on payload bytes

Pool all 55 x 18 = 990 payload bytes and test uniformity
across the 45 GPS ICD symbols.

| Quantity | Value |
|---|---|
| Total payload bytes | 990 |
| GPS ICD symbols | 45 |
| Expected per symbol | 22.00 |
| Chi-squared statistic | 41.82 (df = 44) |
| **p-value** | **5.66e-01** |

| 1 | Shared substrings (L=6) | 4.67e-11 | Yes |
| 1 | Shared substrings (L=9) | < 10^-100 | Yes |
| 2 | TEXT prefix frequency | < 10^-100 | Yes |
| 2 | TEXT PRN concentration | 1.25e-18 | Yes |
| 3 | TEXT entropy ranking (binomial) | 2.85e-18 | Yes |
| 3 | TEXT entropy ranking (Wilcoxon) | < 10^-100 | Yes |
| 4 | Sentinel messages | < 10^-100 | Yes |
| 5 | KS: GPS vs random baseline | 2.04e-20 | Yes (negligible effect size) |
| 7a | TEXT payload KS (PPM-D) | 4.15e-01 | No |
| 7b | TEXT payload chi-squared GOF | 5.66e-01 | No |

All p-values are computed under the null hypothesis that GPS special messages
are independent random draws from the 45-symbol GPS ICD alphabet (IS-GPS-200).
